instructions_to_main_agent: Build a breathtaking, Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level single-page personal portfolio for Richard Allen Doss.

Strictly adhere to the resume data provided for Richard Allen Doss (AI/ML & Software Engineering roles, education, Canopy project featured first with project detail view/modal, leadership & hackathons, education, coding practice).
Include content in src/data/content.js for easy editing.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-reveals and micro-interactions.
Include a distinctive product name and original SVG logo/favicon.
Include resume download, GitHub, LinkedIn, email links, SEO metadata, and sitemap.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Make sure the hero features a kinetic masked line-by-line reveal and subtle 3D/parallax depth.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use universal transitions like transition: all.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs for luxury breathing room.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interactive element must have a data-testid attribute.
